decisions.quote: In this study, we attempted to replicate the results of Experiment 1 as carried out by Förster and Denzler (2012). In our two experiments, we were unable to demonstrate support for the hypothesis that global priming enhances creativity relative to local priming.
decisions.reason: Neither replication experiment supported the original finding (Experiment 1 was indecisive in the direction of the null with BF01 = 1.38 and stated not to match FD2012; Experiment 2 strongly supported the null with BF01 = 10.35), and the authors state an explicit overall verdict that they failed to replicate the target study across both experiments.
